description: This file contains unit tests for filesystem operations such as file creation, manipulation, and directory handling using Google's C++ testing framework (gtest). It tests functionalities of classes like File and Directory, ensuring correct behavior of methods such as Create, Open, Write, Read, Move, and directory traversal functions.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file object providing methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, retrieving file name components, moving, and destruction.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory object with methods for creation, validation, traversal, and retrieving directory info.

methods.name: File::Create
methods.description: Creates the file with optional parameters for overwrite or write mode.

methods.name: File::Open
methods.description: Opens the file for read/write operations.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file into a buffer.

methods.name: File::FileName
methods.description: Returns the filename without directory path.

methods.name: File::PathName
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the file.

methods.name: Directory::CreatePath
methods.description: Creates directory path if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: Directory::Next
methods.description: Moves to the next entry in the directory traversal.

methods.name: Directory::Reset
methods.description: Resets directory traversal to initial state.
